# The Tech

> > The Tech is MIT's weekly student newspaper providing comprehensive coverage of campus news, research, culture, and student life.

The Tech serves the MIT community as an independent student-run publication covering breaking news, opinion, arts, sports, science research, and campus life. The publication maintains editorial independence while engaging readers through investigative journalism, student perspectives, and multimedia coverage of events affecting the MIT community.

## Key Topics

- MIT community
- student government
- campus news
- campus events
- student life
- MIT research
- admissions
- UA elections
- budget controversy
- defense funding
- campus policy
- student activism
- interviews
- news roundup
- cultural events

## News & Opinion

- [News](https://thetech.com/news): Breaking news and coverage of MIT campus events
- [Opinion](https://thetech.com/opinion): Editorial section featuring student activism and campus policy analysis
- [Contentious UA debate follows recent budget controversy](https://thetech.com/2026/03/17/ua-debate-26): Article covering UA presidential debate and student government budget issues

## Campus & Student Life

- [Campus Life](https://thetech.com/campus-life): Student essays and experiences from the MIT community
- [Sports](https://thetech.com/sports): Coverage of MIT athletics and college sports
- [Arts](https://thetech.com/arts): Reviews of books, concerts, and cultural events
- [Photos](https://thetech.com/photos): Photo gallery of MIT campus events and community

## Science & Research

- [Science](https://thetech.com/science): Coverage of MIT research breakthroughs and health innovation
